Vulkan Memory Allocator, vendored from [GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator) tag `v3.4.0` (MIT, see `LICENSE.txt`). Only `include/vk_mem_alloc.h` is kept; `../vma.cpp` compiles its implementation.
